entities.name: Zoltán Kuhárszky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zoltán Kuhárszky is a former tennis player from Hungary who became a Swiss citizen in 1995. Kuharszky won two doubles titles during his professional career. He reached his highest singles ATP ranking on July 30, 1984, when he became the number 53 in the world, though he never won a singles title in his career.
